prompt: A luminous robed shepherd in bone-white and pale-gold vestments hovers in the air, a long crook-staff in one hand, while a flock of small translucent pale-cyan spirit-wisps drifts and follows the staff like sheep. The shepherd has faint feathered wings and a serene face. The translucent spirits glow softly, the only source of light. The background is a dim moonlit graveyard with distant headstones under a deep indigo night sky.

Close-up side profile of a winged shepherd figure in ash-gray and pale-gold robes reaching a glowing hand downward into an open grave, drawing a translucent pale-cyan spirit up out of the earth toward her hand. Soft cyan light spills from the rising spirit. The background is a foggy moonlit churchyard with leaning headstones under a cold blue night sky.

Wide shot of a tall hooded shepherd in flowing white robes walking across a misty hilltop at dusk, holding aloft a glowing lantern, while a long trailing procession of translucent pale-cyan ghostly spirits floats behind in single file like a flock being led. The lantern is the brightest light. The background is rolling fog-shrouded hills and a pale violet twilight sky with the first stars.

A serene winged guardian in shimmering bone-white armor and pale-gold trim floats with arms spread protectively above three small huddled translucent cyan spirit-children. A faint golden shield of light haloes the group, shielding them. The shield glow is the main light source. The background is a ruined moonlit chapel interior with broken stained-glass arches under a dark blue sky.

A robed shepherd with broad feathered wings hovers in a low twilight sky, facing the viewer, herding a swirling cloud of small translucent pale-cyan spirit-wisps with a shepherds crook. The wisps spiral around the staff. Soft cyan and gold glow. The background is a wide pale-amber dusk sky over a dark silhouetted forest treeline.

A winged shepherd in bone-white and pale-gold robes flies low over a moonlit meadow, leaning down to scoop a single translucent pale-cyan lamb-shaped spirit up into her cradling arm while other cyan spirit-wisps drift nearby. The cradled spirit glows brightest. The background is a silver moonlit grassy field with a low stone wall under a dark teal night sky.

Front-facing winged shepherd in flowing white and gold robes hovering above the ground, holding a tall wooden crook, surrounded on all sides by a circling flock of small translucent pale-cyan spirit-wisps shaped like little ghosts. The wisps orbit her in a ring. Warm gold halo light from the figure. The background is a soft pale-amber dawn sky over a dim grassy churchyard.

A robed shepherd with feathered wings stands on a misty hilltop crest in side profile, crook-staff planted, gathering a wide drifting flock of translucent pale-cyan spirit-wisps that stream in from the left toward the staff like sheep coming home. Cyan glow on the wisps, warm gold rim-light on the shepherd. The background is a layered violet-and-rose dusk sky over soft rolling fog.

Low worms-eye view looking up at a winged shepherd in white-and-gold robes silhouetted against a bright full moon, crook held high, a swirling spiral of translucent pale-cyan spirit-wisps funneling upward around her toward the moon. The moon and wisps are the light. The background is a deep indigo starlit night sky with thin clouds.

A serene winged shepherd in bone-white and pale-gold vestments hovers above a dim graveyard, one glowing hand extended downward, lifting a translucent pale-cyan spirit up from a headstone back toward a flock of cyan wisps gathered at her shoulder. The rising spirit trails cyan light. The background is a moonlit cemetery of pale headstones under a cold blue-violet night sky.
